items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: He's a friend of mine. We all belong to the same lodge.

ctx.x: This was around in '49-'50-'51. Harry Ball had a group upstairs, and he had a good trio, and John Hammond had already set up a record date for him. But you know Marlo was irresponsible too. And when you come down for that date, he don't show. Like when we were down at the Stables I was working with Mr. Page. Mario was on piano. And (unintelligible) be looking around to see if he's coming. He'd come in just in time after we'd played the show. So Lips said, what am I going to do with him? I said, forget about him.…
